#!/usr/bin/env bash
# deploy-network.sh - socket/OpenFlow network installer for operation-dbus-proto
#
# Current model:
#   - wg0 is the host WireGuard identity/session server. The script verifies
#     it by default and only rewrites it when --update-wgconf is provided.
#   - wgcf is the bridge-facing WireGuard/WARP tunnel, managed by wg-quick.
#     Its config is only generated/refreshed when --update-wgcf is provided.
#   - ovsbr0 and internal privacy ports are installed through netplan plus
#     native OVSDB/OpenFlow attach scripts.
#   - Socket-mode Incus containers have no veth, no eth0, and no IP address.
#   - Host nginx reaches system services through /run/services0/*.sock.
#   - NextDNS split DNS is managed through the NextDNS API, not dnsmasq.

set -euo pipefail

SCRIPT_DIR="$(CDPATH='' cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"

LOG_FILE="${LOG_FILE:-/var/log/deploy-network.log}"
OP_DBUS_ENV_FILE="${OP_DBUS_ENV_FILE:-/etc/op-dbus/environment}"

SERVICES_CONTAINER="${OP_DBUS_SERVICES_CONTAINER:-services}"
SOCKET_DIR="${SERVICES0_SOCKET_DIR:-/run/services0}"
SOCKET_GROUP="${SERVICES0_SOCKET_GROUP:-_nginx}"
SOCKET_GROUP_ID="${SERVICES0_SOCKET_GID:-980}"

WG_SERVER_INTERFACE="${WG_SERVER_INTERFACE:-${WG_INTERFACE:-wg0}}"
WG_SERVER_ADDRESS="${WG_SERVER_ADDRESS:-10.0.0.1/24}"
WG_SERVER_LISTEN_PORT="${WG_SERVER_LISTEN_PORT:-51820}"
WG_SERVER_PRIVATE_KEY_FILE="${WG_SERVER_PRIVATE_KEY_FILE:-/etc/wireguard/${WG_SERVER_INTERFACE}.netplan.key}"
WG_SERVER_NETPLAN_FILE="${WG_SERVER_NETPLAN_FILE:-/etc/netplan/02-${WG_SERVER_INTERFACE}.yaml}"
WG_SERVER_PEERS="${WG_SERVER_PEERS:-}"

WGCF_INTERFACE="${OP_DBUS_WGCF_INTERFACE:-wgcf}"
WGCF_CONF="/etc/wireguard/${WGCF_INTERFACE}.conf"
WGCF_ACCOUNT_FILE="${WGCF_ACCOUNT_FILE:-/etc/wireguard/wgcf-account.toml}"
OVS_BRIDGE="${OP_DBUS_OVS_BRIDGE:-ovsbr0}"
GRPC_BRIDGE_IFACE="${OP_DBUS_GRPC_BRIDGE_IFACE:-grpc-bridge}"

## `.zenflow/tasks/new-task-3ea6/requirements.md`

```markdown
# Socket-Based Container Networking — Product Requirements Document

## Overview

The `services` Incus container (running OpenClaw gateway, Maddy mail, NextDNS)
must be reachable from WireGuard-authenticated clients without exposing any
container IP address or TCP port. The access path is:

```
WireGuard client → host wg0 → nginx (10.0.0.1) → Unix socket → container loopback
```

This document defines what the system must do. Implementation details are in
`spec.md`.

## Problem Statement

Previously the `services` container had an `eth0` NIC on `incusbr0` with a
static IP, and a WireGuard peer (`wg0` at `10.0.0.4`). This exposed container
IPs to the network, created scannable TCP ports, and required a separate
WireGuard peer per container. The goal is to eliminate all of that.

## User Stories

**US-1** — As a WireGuard client (tablet, laptop), I can reach the OpenClaw
gateway at `https://dashboard.3tched.com/gateway/` without knowing or routing
to any container IP address.

**US-2** — As an operator, I can add a new service to the `services` container
by adding a socat bridge unit and an nginx location block, without changing
container networking.

**US-3** — As a security reviewer, I can verify that no container has a
routable IP or open TCP port by inspecting `/proc/net/dev` inside each
container.

**US-4** — As an operator, I can run `deploy/deploy-network.sh` on a fresh
host and have the full socket gateway path come up without manual steps.

**US-5** — As a WireGuard client, `dashboard.3tched.com` resolves to
`10.0.0.1` through NextDNS split DNS so my browser reaches the WG-bound nginx
listener automatically.

## Functional Requirements

### FR-1: No container network interfaces
Socket-mode containers MUST have only `lo`. No veth, no `eth0`, no `wg0`.

### FR-2: Default Incus profile has no NIC
The Incus `default` profile MUST NOT define an `eth0` device.

### FR-3: Services bind to loopback
All services inside `services` MUST bind to `127.0.0.1` only.

### FR-4: Unix socket bridge per service
Each service needing host access MUST have a socat bridge from
`/run/services0/<name>.sock` to `127.0.0.1:<port>`.

Current required bridge: `gateway.sock → 127.0.0.1:18789`

### FR-5: Shared socket directory `/run/services0`
The `services` container MUST have an Incus disk device `services0` mounting
`/run/services0` from host into container at the same path.

### FR-6: Per-user socket directories
User containers created by the magic-link flow MUST receive
`/run/user-sockets/<container-id>` on the host, mounted as `/run/sockets`
inside the container.

### FR-7: Container identity metadata
- System containers: `user.function = system-services`
- User containers: `user.wg-pubkey = <key>`, name = `user-<sha256(key)[:12]>`

### FR-8: nginx is the only network-facing proxy
nginx on the host MUST proxy `/gateway/` to
`http://unix:/run/services0/gateway.sock:/` on the WG-bound listener only.

### FR-9: No stack-revealing service names
There MUST NOT be an active `openclaw.3tched.com` nginx config. The public
path is `/gateway/` under `dashboard.3tched.com`.

### FR-10: WireGuard gates dashboard access
The dashboard nginx server block MUST listen on `10.0.0.1:80` and
`10.0.0.1:443` only. Public IP listeners for `dashboard.3tched.com` return
`404` (certificate sink only).

### FR-11: Token auth injected by nginx
nginx MUST inject the OpenClaw bearer token. The token MUST NOT appear in
documentation or specs — use `<redacted>`.

### FR-12: One gateway process owner
Only the root systemd unit inside `services` may own port `18789`. The
user-level `jeremy` unit MUST remain disabled.

### FR-13: NextDNS split DNS
NextDNS profile `689ec7` MUST carry a rewrite: `dashboard.3tched.com → 10.0.0.1`.

## Non-Functional Requirements

### NFR-1: Reduced attack surface
No container IPs, no container TCP ports, no per-service subdomains.

### NFR-2: Low-latency local transport
Host-to-container hop uses Unix sockets (no TCP/IP routing between namespaces).

### NFR-3: Boot resilience
`/run/services0` is tmpfs and MUST be recreated before Incus and nginx start.
The `services0-sockets` dinit service owns this. Incus and nginx MUST depend
on it.

### NFR-4: Deployment script is idempotent
`deploy/deploy-network.sh` default runs MUST NOT rotate WireGuard keys or
rewrite WireGuard config. Those are opt-in via `--update-wgconf` /
`--update-wgcf`.

### NFR-5: Verification-first
Changes MUST be verifiable with read-only checks before and after:
- `incus exec services -- cat /proc/net/dev`
- `doas curl --unix-socket /run/services0/gateway.sock http://localhost/`
- `curl -sk https://10.0.0.1/gateway/ -H 'Host: dashboard.3tched.com'`

## Out of Scope

- `privacy-xray-ingress` and `xray-server` migration (separate task)
- NextDNS rewrite automation when `NEXTDNS_API_KEY` is unavailable
- OpenFlow `sock_*` dynamic container port model (future)
- gRPC-over-Unix-socket refactor for `op-dbus` ↔ OpenClaw (separate task)
```

```markdown
# Socket-Based Container Networking — Technical Specification

## Context

- **Host OS**: Chimera Linux (dinit init, Alpine-style nginx at `/etc/nginx/http.d/`)
- **Container runtime**: Incus
- **Language**: Bash (deploy scripts), systemd units (inside container)
- **Key tools**: socat, nginx, wg-quick, netplan, native OVSDB JSON-RPC

## Current State (verified 2026-04-13)

| Component | State |
|---|---|
| `services` container | Running, loopback only (`lo` only in `/proc/net/dev`) |
| `user-be7efab0cc2a` | Running, loopback only |
| Incus `default` profile | Root disk only, no `eth0` |
| `/run/services0` | Host tmpfs dir, shared into `services` |
| `/run/services0/gateway.sock` | Unix socket, mode `srw-rw----`, group `_nginx` |
| `openclaw-gateway.service` | Enabled/running as root in `services` |
| `openclaw-socket.service` | Enabled/running in `services` |
| `services0-sockets` dinit | Running on host |
| nginx dashboard config | `/etc/nginx/http.d/dashboard-3tched.conf` |
| `wg0` | `10.0.0.1/24`, port `51820` |

## Architecture

```
WireGuard client (10.0.0.x)
  │  [WG encrypted]
  ▼
host wg0 (10.0.0.1)
  │
  ▼
nginx (10.0.0.1:443)
  │  dashboard.3tched.com /gateway/
  ▼
/run/services0/gateway.sock   ← shared tmpfs mount
  │  [Unix socket, host side]
  ▼
socat (inside services container)
  │  UNIX-LISTEN → TCP:127.0.0.1:18789
  ▼
OpenClaw gateway (127.0.0.1:18789)
```

The OVS/OpenFlow privacy fabric (`wgcf → ovsbr0 → priv_*`) is a separate
dataplane. Current OpenClaw traffic does NOT traverse `ovsbr0`.

## Component Specifications

### 1. Host dinit: `services0-sockets`

**File**: `/etc/dinit.d/services0-sockets`
```
type = scripted
command = /etc/dinit.d/scripts/services0-sockets.sh
```

**Script**: `/etc/dinit.d/scripts/services0-sockets.sh`
- Creates `/run/services0` with `root:_nginx` `0770`
- Fixes permissions on `gateway.sock` if it already exists
- Must run before `incus` and `nginx` dinit services

**Existing file**: `deploy/dinit/services0-sockets` + `deploy/dinit/scripts/services0-sockets.sh`

### 2. Container systemd: `openclaw-gateway.service`

**Location inside `services`**: `/etc/systemd/system/openclaw-gateway.service`

Key properties:
- `ExecStart`: `/usr/bin/node /usr/lib/node_modules/openclaw/dist/index.js gateway --port 18789`
- `Environment=HOME=/root`
- `WantedBy=default.target`
- Must be enabled; user-level unit at `/home/jeremy/.config/systemd/user/openclaw-gateway.service` must be disabled

**OpenClaw config** (`/root/.openclaw/openclaw.json`):
```json
{
  "gateway": {
    "mode": "local",
    "port": 18789,
    "bind": "custom",
    "customBindHost": "127.0.0.1",
    "trustedProxies": ["127.0.0.1"]
  }
}
```

### 3. Container systemd: `openclaw-socket.service`

**Location inside `services`**: `/etc/systemd/system/openclaw-socket.service`

**Existing source**: `deploy/systemd/openclaw-socket.service`

```ini
[Unit]
Description=OpenClaw Unix Socket Bridge
After=openclaw-gateway.service
Requires=openclaw-gateway.service

[Service]
ExecStartPre=/bin/rm -f /run/services0/gateway.sock
ExecStart=/usr/bin/socat UNIX-LISTEN:/run/services0/gateway.sock,fork,mode=660,gid=980 TCP:127.0.0.1:18789
Restart=always
RestartSec=2

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
```

The `gid=980` corresponds to `_nginx` group (GID 980 on this host).

### 4. Incus container config: `services`

Required devices:
```yaml
services0:
  type: disk
  source: /run/services0
  path: /run/services0
openclaw-home:
  type: disk
  source: /home/jeremy/.openclaw
  path: /home/jeremy/.openclaw
```

Required metadata:
```yaml
user.function: system-services
```

No NIC device. No proxy device.

### 5. nginx: `dashboard-3tched.conf`

**Location on host**: `/etc/nginx/http.d/dashboard-3tched.conf`

**Source template**: `deploy/nginx/dashboard-3tched-socket.conf.template`

Four server blocks:
1. `148.113.204.83:80` — sink, `return 404`
2. `148.113.204.83:443 ssl` — sink, `return 404`, uses `3tched.com` cert
3. `10.0.0.1:80` — redirect to HTTPS
4. `10.0.0.1:443 ssl` — gateway route

Block 4 location:
```nginx
location /gateway/ {
    proxy_pass http://unix:/run/services0/gateway.sock:/;
    proxy_http_version 1.1;
    proxy_set_header Host $host;
    proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;
    proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
    proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;
    proxy_set_header Upgrade $http_upgrade;
    proxy_set_header Connection $connection_upgrade;
    proxy_set_header Authorization "Bearer <redacted>";
    proxy_read_timeout 7d;
}
```

The `connection_upgrade` map variable is already defined in the host
`/etc/nginx/nginx.conf`.

### 6. deploy-network.sh integration

**Existing file**: `deploy/deploy-network.sh`

The script already handles:
- `services0-sockets` dinit install
- `openclaw-socket.service` install into container
- `--install-dashboard-nginx` flag renders the template
- `--update-wgconf` / `--update-wgcf` flags for WireGuard writes
- NextDNS rewrite via `deploy/nextdns/upsert-rewrite.py`

### 7. User container template

Name: `user-<sha256(wg_pubkey)[:12]>`

Devices:
```yaml
sockets:
  type: disk
  source: /run/user-sockets/<container-id>
  path: /run/sockets
```

Metadata: `user.wg-pubkey: <key>`

Host directory `/run/user-sockets/<container-id>` must be created before
container start (tmpfs, recreated on boot).

## Filesystem Permissions

| Path | Owner | Mode |
|---|---|---|
| `/run/services0` | `root:_nginx` | `0770` |
| `/run/services0/gateway.sock` | `root:_nginx` | `0660` |
| `/run/user-sockets` | `root:root` | `0755` |
| `/run/user-sockets/<id>` | `root:root` | `0777` |

## Verification Commands

```sh
# Container has no network interfaces except lo
incus exec services -- cat /proc/net/dev

# OpenClaw is listening on loopback only
incus exec services -- ss -tlnp | grep 18789

# Socket exists and responds
doas curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' \
  --unix-socket /run/services0/gateway.sock http://localhost/

# nginx WG route works
curl -sk -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' \
  https://10.0.0.1/gateway/ -H 'Host: dashboard.3tched.com'

# Public IP is a sink
curl -sk -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' \
  https://148.113.204.83/gateway/ -H 'Host: dashboard.3tched.com'
# expected: 404

# User-level OpenClaw unit is disabled
incus exec services -- \
  systemctl --user --machine=jeremy@ is-enabled openclaw-gateway.service
# expected: disabled
```

## Known Gaps

1. `privacy-xray-ingress` and `xray-server` still have `eth0`.
2. NextDNS rewrite requires `NEXTDNS_API_KEY` (not present on host).
3. `wgcf` handshake was stale at last check — affects privacy fabric only.
4. `wg0.conf` has invalid `DNS=` lines in `[Peer]` sections — must be fixed
   before `wg-quick up wg0` works reliably.
```

Based on `spec.md`. Each task produces a working, verifiable increment.

## Task 1: Fix wg0.conf and verify host WireGuard

**Objective**: Ensure host `wg0` comes up cleanly so the nginx WG listener
works.

**Implementation**:
- Remove `DNS =` lines from all `[Peer]` sections in `/etc/wireguard/wg0.conf`
  (DNS is only valid under `[Interface]`)
- Bring up `wg0` with `doas wg-quick up wg0`
- Verify `ip addr show wg0` shows `10.0.0.1/24`

**Verification**:
```sh
doas wg show wg0
ip addr show wg0
ping -c1 -W2 10.0.0.1
```

**Demo**: `wg0` is up at `10.0.0.1/24`, `wg show wg0` lists peers without
error.

---

## Task 2: Ensure `/run/services0` is created at boot

**Objective**: The shared socket directory exists with correct permissions
before Incus and nginx start.

**Implementation**:
- Install `deploy/dinit/services0-sockets` → `/etc/dinit.d/services0-sockets`
- Install `deploy/dinit/scripts/services0-sockets.sh` →
  `/etc/dinit.d/scripts/services0-sockets.sh`
- Add `depends-on = services0-sockets` to the `incus` and `nginx` dinit
  service files
- Start the service: `doas dinitctl start services0-sockets`

**Verification**:
```sh
ls -la /run/services0
# expected: drwxrwx--- root _nginx
doas dinitctl status services0-sockets
# expected: STARTED
```

**Demo**: `/run/services0` exists with `root:_nginx 0770` after a reboot.

---

## Task 3: Configure `services` container — no NIC, correct mounts

**Objective**: Container has only `lo`, has the `services0` disk mount, and
carries the `user.function` metadata.

**Implementation**:
- Remove `eth0` NIC device if present:
  `incus config device remove services eth0`
- Remove `smtp25` proxy device if present:
  `incus config device remove services smtp25`
- Add `services0` disk device:
  `incus config device add services services0 disk source=/run/services0 path=/run/services0`
- Set metadata:
  `incus config set services user.function system-services`
- Remove container `wg0` if still up:
  `incus exec services -- wg-quick down wg0 2>/dev/null || true`

**Verification**:
```sh
incus exec services -- cat /proc/net/dev
# only lo line
incus config device show services | grep services0
incus config get services user.function
# system-services
```

**Demo**: `incus list` shows no IP for `services`; `/proc/net/dev` inside
shows only `lo`.

---

## Task 4: Configure OpenClaw to bind loopback only

**Objective**: OpenClaw gateway listens on `127.0.0.1:18789` inside the
container, not on any network interface.

**Implementation**:
- Edit `/root/.openclaw/openclaw.json` inside `services`:
  - `gateway.bind = "custom"`
  - `gateway.customBindHost = "127.0.0.1"`
  - `gateway.trustedProxies = ["127.0.0.1"]`
- Disable the user-level unit:
  `incus exec services -- systemctl --user --machine=jeremy@ disable openclaw-gateway.service`
  `incus exec services -- systemctl --user --machine=jeremy@ stop openclaw-gateway.service`
- Restart the root unit:
  `incus exec services -- systemctl restart openclaw-gateway.service`

**Verification**:
```sh
incus exec services -- ss -tlnp | grep 18789
# expected: 127.0.0.1:18789
incus exec services -- systemctl is-active openclaw-gateway.service
# active
incus exec services -- \
  systemctl --user --machine=jeremy@ is-enabled openclaw-gateway.service
# disabled
```

**Demo**: `ss -tlnp` inside container shows only `127.0.0.1:18789`.

---

## Task 5: Install and start `openclaw-socket.service` inside container

**Objective**: socat bridges `/run/services0/gateway.sock` to
`127.0.0.1:18789` inside the container.

**Implementation**:
- Copy `deploy/systemd/openclaw-socket.service` into the container:
  `incus file push deploy/systemd/openclaw-socket.service \`
  `  services/etc/systemd/system/openclaw-socket.service`
- Enable and start:
  `incus exec services -- systemctl enable openclaw-socket.service`
  `incus exec services -- systemctl start openclaw-socket.service`

**Verification**:
```sh
incus exec services -- systemctl is-active openclaw-socket.service
# active
ls -la /run/services0/gateway.sock
# srw-rw---- root _nginx
doas curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' \
  --unix-socket /run/services0/gateway.sock http://localhost/
# 200
```

**Demo**: `curl` via Unix socket returns HTTP 200 from OpenClaw.

---

## Task 6: Install nginx dashboard config

**Objective**: nginx proxies `/gateway/` to the Unix socket on the WG
listener; public IP is a sink.

**Implementation**:
- Render `deploy/nginx/dashboard-3tched-socket.conf.template` with the
  gateway token:
  `OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_TOKEN=<token> deploy/deploy-network.sh --install-dashboard-nginx`
  OR manually copy `deploy/nginx/dashboard.3tched.com.conf` to
  `/etc/nginx/http.d/dashboard-3tched.conf`
- Disable legacy config if present:
  `mv /etc/nginx/http.d/openclaw-3tched.conf \`
  `   /etc/nginx/http.d/openclaw-3tched.conf.disabled 2>/dev/null || true`
- Test and reload:
  `doas nginx -t && doas nginx -s reload`

**Verification**:
```sh
doas nginx -t
curl -sk -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' \
  https://10.0.0.1/gateway/ -H 'Host: dashboard.3tched.com'
# 200
curl -sk -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' \
  https://148.113.204.83/gateway/ -H 'Host: dashboard.3tched.com'
# 404
```

**Demo**: WG-bound route returns 200; public IP returns 404.

---

## Task 7: Apply NextDNS split DNS rewrite

**Objective**: WireGuard clients resolve `dashboard.3tched.com` to `10.0.0.1`
so browsers hit the WG-bound nginx listener.

**Implementation**:
```sh
NEXTDNS_API_KEY=<key> NEXTDNS_PROFILE=689ec7 \
  deploy/nextdns/upsert-rewrite.py dashboard.3tched.com 10.0.0.1
```

**Prerequisite**: `NEXTDNS_API_KEY` must be available. If not, skip and note
as a gap.

**Verification**:
- From a WG-connected device: `nslookup dashboard.3tched.com` → `10.0.0.1`
- Browser navigation to `https://dashboard.3tched.com/gateway/` works

**Demo**: Browser on WG client reaches OpenClaw at the generic dashboard URL.

---

## Task 8: Wire `deploy-network.sh` and verify full boot sequence

**Objective**: A single `deploy/deploy-network.sh` run installs and starts
all socket networking components idempotently.

**Implementation**:
- Verify the script installs: `services0-sockets` dinit, `openclaw-socket.service`,
  OVS attach ports, wg-quick-all, netplan
- Add any missing install steps to the script for the socket bridge
- Test a full run: `doas deploy/deploy-network.sh`
- Simulate reboot: verify `/run/services0` is recreated and gateway is
  reachable after `dinitctl restart incus`

**Verification**:
```sh
doas deploy/deploy-network.sh --verify-only
# all checks pass
```

**Demo**: After a simulated reboot, `curl --unix-socket /run/services0/gateway.sock http://localhost/` returns 200 without manual intervention.

---

## Task 9: Create mock user container template

**Objective**: Establish the user container pattern for the magic-link
workflow.

**Implementation**:
- Create host directory: `doas mkdir -p /run/user-sockets/be7efab0cc2a`
- Ensure `user-be7efab0cc2a` container exists with:
  - No NIC device
  - `sockets` disk device: source `/run/user-sockets/be7efab0cc2a`, path `/run/sockets`
  - Metadata: `user.wg-pubkey = <key>`
- Document the name derivation: `user-<sha256(wg_pubkey)[:12]>`

**Verification**:
```sh
incus exec user-be7efab0cc2a -- cat /proc/net/dev
# only lo
incus config device show user-be7efab0cc2a | grep sockets
incus config get user-be7efab0cc2a user.wg-pubkey
```

**Demo**: User container has no IP, has `/run/sockets` mount, carries WG
pubkey metadata.

---

## Gaps Deferred to Future Tasks

- `privacy-xray-ingress` and `xray-server` migration to socket-only
- OpenFlow `sock_*` dynamic container port model
- gRPC-over-Unix-socket refactor for `op-dbus` ↔ OpenClaw
```

## requirements.md content

```markdown
# Socket-Based Container Networking — Product Requirements Document

## Overview

The `services` Incus container (running OpenClaw gateway, Maddy mail, NextDNS)
must be reachable from WireGuard-authenticated clients without exposing any
container IP address or TCP port. The access path is:

```
WireGuard client → host wg0 → nginx (10.0.0.1) → Unix socket → container loopback
```

## Problem Statement

Previously the `services` container had an `eth0` NIC on `incusbr0` with a
static IP, and a WireGuard peer (`wg0` at `10.0.0.4`). This exposed container
IPs to the network, created scannable TCP ports, and required a separate
WireGuard peer per container. The goal is to eliminate all of that.

## User Stories

**US-1** — As a WireGuard client (tablet, laptop), I can reach the OpenClaw
gateway at `https://dashboard.3tched.com/gateway/` without knowing or routing
to any container IP address.

**US-2** — As an operator, I can add a new service to the `services` container
by adding a socat bridge unit and an nginx location block, without changing
container networking.

**US-3** — As a security reviewer, I can verify that no container has a
routable IP or open TCP port by inspecting `/proc/net/dev` inside each
container.

**US-4** — As an operator, I can run `deploy/deploy-network.sh` on a fresh
host and have the full socket gateway path come up without manual steps.

**US-5** — As a WireGuard client, `dashboard.3tched.com` resolves to
`10.0.0.1` through NextDNS split DNS so my browser reaches the WG-bound nginx
listener automatically.

## Functional Requirements

### FR-1: No container network interfaces
Socket-mode containers MUST have only `lo`. No veth, no `eth0`, no `wg0`.

### FR-2: Default Incus profile has no NIC
The Incus `default` profile MUST NOT define an `eth0` device.

### FR-3: Services bind to loopback
All services inside `services` MUST bind to `127.0.0.1` only.

### FR-4: Unix socket bridge per service
Each service needing host access MUST have a socat bridge from
`/run/services0/<name>.sock` to `127.0.0.1:<port>`.

Current required bridge: `gateway.sock → 127.0.0.1:18789`

### FR-5: Shared socket directory `/run/services0`
The `services` container MUST have an Incus disk device `services0` mounting
`/run/services0` from host into container at the same path.

### FR-6: Per-user socket directories
User containers created by the magic-link flow MUST receive
`/run/user-sockets/<container-id>` on the host, mounted as `/run/sockets`
inside the container.

### FR-7: Container identity metadata
- System containers: `user.function = system-services`
- User containers: `user.wg-pubkey = <key>`, name = `user-<sha256(key)[:12]>`

### FR-8: nginx is the only network-facing proxy
nginx on the host MUST proxy `/gateway/` to
`http://unix:/run/services0/gateway.sock:/` on the WG-bound listener only.

### FR-9: No stack-revealing service names
There MUST NOT be an active `openclaw.3tched.com` nginx config. The public
path is `/gateway/` under `dashboard.3tched.com`.

### FR-10: WireGuard gates dashboard access
The dashboard nginx server block MUST listen on `10.0.0.1:80` and
`10.0.0.1:443` only. Public IP listeners for `dashboard.3tched.com` return
`404` (certificate sink only).

### FR-11: Token auth injected by nginx
nginx MUST inject the OpenClaw bearer token. The token MUST NOT appear in
documentation or specs — use `<redacted>`.

### FR-12: One gateway process owner
Only the root systemd unit inside `services` may own port `18789`. The
user-level `jeremy` unit MUST remain disabled.

### FR-13: NextDNS split DNS
NextDNS profile `689ec7` MUST carry a rewrite: `dashboard.3tched.com → 10.0.0.1`.

## Non-Functional Requirements

### NFR-1: Reduced attack surface
No container IPs, no container TCP ports, no per-service subdomains.

### NFR-2: Low-latency local transport
Host-to-container hop uses Unix sockets (no TCP/IP routing between namespaces).

### NFR-3: Boot resilience
`/run/services0` is tmpfs and MUST be recreated before Incus and nginx start.
The `services0-sockets` dinit service owns this. Incus and nginx MUST depend
on it.

### NFR-4: Deployment script is idempotent
`deploy/deploy-network.sh` default runs MUST NOT rotate WireGuard keys or
rewrite WireGuard config. Those are opt-in via `--update-wgconf` /
`--update-wgcf`.

### NFR-5: Verification-first
Changes MUST be verifiable with read-only checks before and after:
- `incus exec services -- cat /proc/net/dev`
- `doas curl --unix-socket /run/services0/gateway.sock http://localhost/`
- `curl -sk https://10.0.0.1/gateway/ -H 'Host: dashboard.3tched.com'`

## Out of Scope

- `privacy-xray-ingress` and `xray-server` migration (separate task)
- NextDNS rewrite automation when `NEXTDNS_API_KEY` is unavailable
- OpenFlow `sock_*` dynamic container port model (future)
- gRPC-over-Unix-socket refactor for `op-dbus` ↔ OpenClaw (separate task)
```

## spec.md content

```markdown
# Socket-Based Container Networking — Technical Specification

## Context

- **Host OS**: Chimera Linux (dinit init, Alpine-style nginx at `/etc/nginx/http.d/`)
- **Container runtime**: Incus
- **Language**: Bash (deploy scripts), systemd units (inside container)
- **Key tools**: socat, nginx, wg-quick, netplan, native OVSDB JSON-RPC

## Current State (verified 2026-04-13)

| Component | State |
|---|---|
| `services` container | Running, loopback only (`lo` only in `/proc/net/dev`) |
| `user-be7efab0cc2a` | Running, loopback only |
| Incus `default` profile | Root disk only, no `eth0` |
| `/run/services0` | Host tmpfs dir, shared into `services` |
| `/run/services0/gateway.sock` | Unix socket, mode `srw-rw----`, group `_nginx` |
| `openclaw-gateway.service` | Enabled/running as root in `services` |
| `openclaw-socket.service` | Enabled/running in `services` |
| `services0-sockets` dinit | Running on host |
| nginx dashboard config | `/etc/nginx/http.d/dashboard-3tched.conf` |
| `wg0` | `10.0.0.1/24`, port `51820` |

## Architecture

```
WireGuard client (10.0.0.x)
  │  [WG encrypted]
  ▼
host wg0 (10.0.0.1)
  │
  ▼
nginx (10.0.0.1:443)
  │  dashboard.3tched.com /gateway/
  ▼
/run/services0/gateway.sock   ← shared tmpfs mount
  │  [Unix socket, host side]
  ▼
socat (inside services container)
  │  UNIX-LISTEN → TCP:127.0.0.1:18789
  ▼
OpenClaw gateway (127.0.0.1:18789)
```

The OVS/OpenFlow privacy fabric (`wgcf → ovsbr0 → priv_*`) is a separate
dataplane. Current OpenClaw traffic does NOT traverse `ovsbr0`.

## Component Specifications

### 1. Host dinit: `services0-sockets`

**File**: `/etc/dinit.d/services0-sockets`
```
type = scripted
command = /etc/dinit.d/scripts/services0-sockets.sh
```

**Script**: `/etc/dinit.d/scripts/services0-sockets.sh`
- Creates `/run/services0` with `root:_nginx` `0770`
- Fixes permissions on `gateway.sock` if it already exists
- Must run before `incus` and `nginx` dinit services

**Existing source files**: `deploy/dinit/services0-sockets` + `deploy/dinit/scripts/services0-sockets.sh`

### 2. Container systemd: `openclaw-gateway.service`

**Location inside `services`**: `/etc/systemd/system/openclaw-gateway.service`

Key properties:
- `ExecStart`: `/usr/bin/node /usr/lib/node_modules/openclaw/dist/index.js gateway --port 18789`
- `Environment=HOME=/root`
- `WantedBy=default.target`
- Must be enabled; user-level unit at `/home/jeremy/.config/systemd/user/openclaw-gateway.service` must be disabled

**OpenClaw config** (`/root/.openclaw/openclaw.json`):
```json
{
  "gateway": {
    "mode": "local",
    "port": 18789,
    "bind": "custom",
    "customBindHost": "127.0.0.1",
    "trustedProxies": ["127.0.0.1"]
  }
}
```

### 3. Container systemd: `openclaw-socket.service`

**Location inside `services`**: `/etc/systemd/system/openclaw-socket.service`

**Existing source**: `deploy/systemd/openclaw-socket.service`

```ini
[Unit]
Description=OpenClaw Unix Socket Bridge
After=openclaw-gateway.service
Requires=openclaw-gateway.service

[Service]
ExecStartPre=/bin/rm -f /run/services0/gateway.sock
ExecStart=/usr/bin/socat UNIX-LISTEN:/run/services0/gateway.sock,fork,mode=660,gid=980 TCP:127.0.0.1:18789
Restart=always
RestartSec=2

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
```

The `gid=980` corresponds to `_nginx` group (GID 980 on this host).

### 4. Incus container config: `services`

Required devices:
```yaml
services0:
  type: disk
  source: /run/services0
  path: /run/services0
openclaw-home:
  type: disk
  source: /home/jeremy/.openclaw
  path: /home/jeremy/.openclaw
```

Required metadata:
```yaml
user.function: system-services
```

No NIC device. No proxy device.

### 5. nginx: `dashboard-3tched.conf`

**Location on host**: `/etc/nginx/http.d/dashboard-3tched.conf`

**Source template**: `deploy/nginx/dashboard-3tched-socket.conf.template`

Four server blocks:
1. `148.113.204.83:80` — sink, `return 404`
2. `148.113.204.83:443 ssl` — sink, `return 404`, uses `3tched.com` cert
3. `10.0.0.1:80` — redirect to HTTPS
4. `10.0.0.1:443 ssl` — gateway route

Block 4 location:
```nginx
location /gateway/ {
    proxy_pass http://unix:/run/services0/gateway.sock:/;
    proxy_http_version 1.1;
    proxy_set_header Host $host;
    proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;
    proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
    proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;
    proxy_set_header Upgrade $http_upgrade;
    proxy_set_header Connection $connection_upgrade;
    proxy_set_header Authorization "Bearer <redacted>";
    proxy_read_timeout 7d;
}
```

### 6. deploy-network.sh integration

**Existing file**: `deploy/deploy-network.sh`

The script already handles:
- `services0-sockets` dinit install
- `openclaw-socket.service` install into container
- `--install-dashboard-nginx` flag renders the template
- `--update-wgconf` / `--update-wgcf` flags for WireGuard writes
- NextDNS rewrite via `deploy/nextdns/upsert-rewrite.py`

### 7. User container template

Name: `user-<sha256(wg_pubkey)[:12]>`

Devices:
```yaml
sockets:
  type: disk
  source: /run/user-sockets/<container-id>
  path: /run/sockets
```

Metadata: `user.wg-pubkey: <key>`

Host directory `/run/user-sockets/<container-id>` must be created before
container start (tmpfs, recreated on boot).

## Filesystem Permissions

| Path | Owner | Mode |
|---|---|---|
| `/run/services0` | `root:_nginx` | `0770` |
| `/run/services0/gateway.sock` | `root:_nginx` | `0660` |
| `/run/user-sockets` | `root:root` | `0755` |
| `/run/user-sockets/<id>` | `root:root` | `0777` |

## Verification Commands

```sh
incus exec services -- cat /proc/net/dev
incus exec services -- ss -tlnp | grep 18789
doas curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' \
  --unix-socket /run/services0/gateway.sock http://localhost/
curl -sk -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' \
  https://10.0.0.1/gateway/ -H 'Host: dashboard.3tched.com'
curl -sk -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' \
  https://148.113.204.83/gateway/ -H 'Host: dashboard.3tched.com'
incus exec services -- \
  systemctl --user --machine=jeremy@ is-enabled openclaw-gateway.service
```

## Known Gaps

1. `privacy-xray-ingress` and `xray-server` still have `eth0`.
2. NextDNS rewrite requires `NEXTDNS_API_KEY` (not present on host).
3. `wgcf` handshake was stale at last check.
4. `wg0.conf` has invalid `DNS=` lines in `[Peer]` sections.
```

# Socket-Based Container Networking — Implementation Plan

Based on `spec.md`. Each task produces a working, verifiable increment.

---

## Task 1: Fix wg0.conf and verify host WireGuard

**Objective**: Ensure host `wg0` comes up cleanly so the nginx WG listener works.

**Implementation**:
- Remove `DNS =` lines from all `[Peer]` sections in `/etc/wireguard/wg0.conf`
  (DNS is only valid under `[Interface]`)
- Bring up `wg0` with `doas wg-quick up wg0`
- Verify `ip addr show wg0` shows `10.0.0.1/24`

**Verification**:
```sh
doas wg show wg0
ip addr show wg0
```

**Demo**: `wg0` is up at `10.0.0.1/24`, `wg show wg0` lists peers without error.

---

## Task 2: Ensure `/run/services0` is created at boot

**Objective**: The shared socket directory exists with correct permissions
before Incus and nginx start.

**Implementation**:
- Install `deploy/dinit/services0-sockets` → `/etc/dinit.d/services0-sockets`
- Install `deploy/dinit/scripts/services0-sockets.sh` → `/etc/dinit.d/scripts/services0-sockets.sh`
- Add `depends-on = services0-sockets` to the `incus` and `nginx` dinit service files
- Start: `doas dinitctl start services0-sockets`

**Verification**:
```sh
ls -la /run/services0
# drwxrwx--- root _nginx
doas dinitctl status services0-sockets
# STARTED
```

**Demo**: `/run/services0` exists with `root:_nginx 0770` after a reboot.

---

## Task 3: Configure `services` container — no NIC, correct mounts

**Objective**: Container has only `lo`, has the `services0` disk mount, and
carries the `user.function` metadata.

**Implementation**:
```sh
incus config device remove services eth0 2>/dev/null || true

## requirements.md content

```markdown
# Socket-Based Container Networking — Product Requirements Document

## Overview

The `services` Incus container (running OpenClaw gateway, Maddy mail, NextDNS)
must be reachable from WireGuard-authenticated clients without exposing any
container IP address or TCP port. The access path is:

```
WireGuard client → host wg0 → nginx (10.0.0.1) → Unix socket → container loopback
```

## Problem Statement

Previously the `services` container had an `eth0` NIC on `incusbr0` with a
static IP, and a WireGuard peer (`wg0` at `10.0.0.4`). This exposed container
IPs to the network, created scannable TCP ports, and required a separate
WireGuard peer per container. The goal is to eliminate all of that.

## User Stories

**US-1** — As a WireGuard client (tablet, laptop), I can reach the OpenClaw
gateway at `https://dashboard.3tched.com/gateway/` without knowing or routing
to any container IP address.

**US-2** — As an operator, I can add a new service to the `services` container
by adding a socat bridge unit and an nginx location block, without changing
container networking.

**US-3** — As a security reviewer, I can verify that no container has a
routable IP or open TCP port by inspecting `/proc/net/dev` inside each
container.

**US-4** — As an operator, I can run `deploy/deploy-network.sh` on a fresh
host and have the full socket gateway path come up without manual steps.

**US-5** — As a WireGuard client, `dashboard.3tched.com` resolves to
`10.0.0.1` through NextDNS split DNS so my browser reaches the WG-bound nginx
listener automatically.

## Functional Requirements

### FR-1: No container network interfaces
Socket-mode containers MUST have only `lo`. No veth, no `eth0`, no `wg0`.

### FR-2: Default Incus profile has no NIC
The Incus `default` profile MUST NOT define an `eth0` device.

### FR-3: Services bind to loopback
All services inside `services` MUST bind to `127.0.0.1` only.

### FR-4: Unix socket bridge per service
Each service needing host access MUST have a socat bridge from
`/run/services0/<name>.sock` to `127.0.0.1:<port>`.

Current required bridge: `gateway.sock → 127.0.0.1:18789`

### FR-5: Shared socket directory `/run/services0`
The `services` container MUST have an Incus disk device `services0` mounting
`/run/services0` from host into container at the same path.

### FR-6: Per-user socket directories
User containers created by the magic-link flow MUST receive
`/run/user-sockets/<container-id>` on the host, mounted as `/run/sockets`
inside the container.

### FR-7: Container identity metadata
- System containers: `user.function = system-services`
- User containers: `user.wg-pubkey = <key>`, name = `user-<sha256(key)[:12]>`

### FR-8: nginx is the only network-facing proxy
nginx on the host MUST proxy `/gateway/` to
`http://unix:/run/services0/gateway.sock:/` on the WG-bound listener only.

### FR-9: No stack-revealing service names
There MUST NOT be an active `openclaw.3tched.com` nginx config. The public
path is `/gateway/` under `dashboard.3tched.com`.

### FR-10: WireGuard gates dashboard access
The dashboard nginx server block MUST listen on `10.0.0.1:80` and
`10.0.0.1:443` only. Public IP listeners for `dashboard.3tched.com` return
`404` (certificate sink only).

### FR-11: Token auth injected by nginx
nginx MUST inject the OpenClaw bearer token. The token MUST NOT appear in
documentation or specs — use `<redacted>`.

### FR-12: One gateway process owner
Only the root systemd unit inside `services` may own port `18789`. The
user-level `jeremy` unit MUST remain disabled.

### FR-13: NextDNS split DNS
NextDNS profile `689ec7` MUST carry a rewrite: `dashboard.3tched.com → 10.0.0.1`.

## Non-Functional Requirements

### NFR-1: Reduced attack surface
No container IPs, no container TCP ports, no per-service subdomains.

### NFR-2: Low-latency local transport
Host-to-container hop uses Unix sockets (no TCP/IP routing between namespaces).

### NFR-3: Boot resilience
`/run/services0` is tmpfs and MUST be recreated before Incus and nginx start.
The `services0-sockets` dinit service owns this. Incus and nginx MUST depend
on it.

### NFR-4: Deployment script is idempotent
`deploy/deploy-network.sh` default runs MUST NOT rotate WireGuard keys or
rewrite WireGuard config. Those are opt-in via `--update-wgconf` /
`--update-wgcf`.

### NFR-5: Verification-first
Changes MUST be verifiable with read-only checks before and after:
- `incus exec services -- cat /proc/net/dev`
- `doas curl --unix-socket /run/services0/gateway.sock http://localhost/`
- `curl -sk https://10.0.0.1/gateway/ -H 'Host: dashboard.3tched.com'`

## Out of Scope

- `privacy-xray-ingress` and `xray-server` migration (separate task)
- NextDNS rewrite automation when `NEXTDNS_API_KEY` is unavailable
- OpenFlow `sock_*` dynamic container port model (future)
- gRPC-over-Unix-socket refactor for `op-dbus` ↔ OpenClaw (separate task)
```

## spec.md content

```markdown
# Socket-Based Container Networking — Technical Specification

## Context

- **Host OS**: Chimera Linux (dinit init, Alpine-style nginx at `/etc/nginx/http.d/`)
- **Container runtime**: Incus
- **Language**: Bash (deploy scripts), systemd units (inside container)
- **Key tools**: socat, nginx, wg-quick, netplan, native OVSDB JSON-RPC

## Current State (verified 2026-04-13)

| Component | State |
|---|---|
| `services` container | Running, loopback only (`lo` only in `/proc/net/dev`) |
| `user-be7efab0cc2a` | Running, loopback only |
| Incus `default` profile | Root disk only, no `eth0` |
| `/run/services0` | Host tmpfs dir, shared into `services` |
| `/run/services0/gateway.sock` | Unix socket, mode `srw-rw----`, group `_nginx` |
| `openclaw-gateway.service` | Enabled/running as root in `services` |
| `openclaw-socket.service` | Enabled/running in `services` |
| `services0-sockets` dinit | Running on host |
| nginx dashboard config | `/etc/nginx/http.d/dashboard-3tched.conf` |
| `wg0` | `10.0.0.1/24`, port `51820` |

## Architecture

```
WireGuard client (10.0.0.x)
  │  [WG encrypted]
  ▼
host wg0 (10.0.0.1)
  │
  ▼
nginx (10.0.0.1:443)
  │  dashboard.3tched.com /gateway/
  ▼
/run/services0/gateway.sock   ← shared tmpfs mount
  │  [Unix socket, host side]
  ▼
socat (inside services container)
  │  UNIX-LISTEN → TCP:127.0.0.1:18789
  ▼
OpenClaw gateway (127.0.0.1:18789)
```

The OVS/OpenFlow privacy fabric (`wgcf → ovsbr0 → priv_*`) is a separate
dataplane. Current OpenClaw traffic does NOT traverse `ovsbr0`.

## Component Specifications

### 1. Host dinit: `services0-sockets`

**File**: `/etc/dinit.d/services0-sockets`
```
type = scripted
command = /etc/dinit.d/scripts/services0-sockets.sh
```

**Script**: `/etc/dinit.d/scripts/services0-sockets.sh`
- Creates `/run/services0` with `root:_nginx` `0770`
- Fixes permissions on `gateway.sock` if it already exists
- Must run before `incus` and `nginx` dinit services

**Existing source files**: `deploy/dinit/services0-sockets` + `deploy/dinit/scripts/services0-sockets.sh`

### 2. Container systemd: `openclaw-gateway.service`

**Location inside `services`**: `/etc/systemd/system/openclaw-gateway.service`

Key properties:
- `ExecStart`: `/usr/bin/node /usr/lib/node_modules/openclaw/dist/index.js gateway --port 18789`
- `Environment=HOME=/root`
- `WantedBy=default.target`
- Must be enabled; user-level unit at `/home/jeremy/.config/systemd/user/openclaw-gateway.service` must be disabled

**OpenClaw config** (`/root/.openclaw/openclaw.json`):
```json
{
  "gateway": {
    "mode": "local",
    "port": 18789,
    "bind": "custom",
    "customBindHost": "127.0.0.1",
    "trustedProxies": ["127.0.0.1"]
  }
}
```

### 3. Container systemd: `openclaw-socket.service`

**Location inside `services`**: `/etc/systemd/system/openclaw-socket.service`

**Existing source**: `deploy/systemd/openclaw-socket.service`

```ini
[Unit]
Description=OpenClaw Unix Socket Bridge
After=openclaw-gateway.service
Requires=openclaw-gateway.service

[Service]
ExecStartPre=/bin/rm -f /run/services0/gateway.sock
ExecStart=/usr/bin/socat UNIX-LISTEN:/run/services0/gateway.sock,fork,mode=660,gid=980 TCP:127.0.0.1:18789
Restart=always
RestartSec=2

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
```

The `gid=980` corresponds to `_nginx` group (GID 980 on this host).

### 4. Incus container config: `services`

Required devices:
```yaml
services0:
  type: disk
  source: /run/services0
  path: /run/services0
openclaw-home:
  type: disk
  source: /home/jeremy/.openclaw
  path: /home/jeremy/.openclaw
```

Required metadata:
```yaml
user.function: system-services
```

No NIC device. No proxy device.

### 5. nginx: `dashboard-3tched.conf`

**Location on host**: `/etc/nginx/http.d/dashboard-3tched.conf`

**Source template**: `deploy/nginx/dashboard-3tched-socket.conf.template`

Four server blocks:
1. `148.113.204.83:80` — sink, `return 404`
2. `148.113.204.83:443 ssl` — sink, `return 404`, uses `3tched.com` cert
3. `10.0.0.1:80` — redirect to HTTPS
4. `10.0.0.1:443 ssl` — gateway route

Block 4 location:
```nginx
location /gateway/ {
    proxy_pass http://unix:/run/services0/gateway.sock:/;
    proxy_http_version 1.1;
    proxy_set_header Host $host;
    proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;
    proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
    proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;
    proxy_set_header Upgrade $http_upgrade;
    proxy_set_header Connection $connection_upgrade;
    proxy_set_header Authorization "Bearer <redacted>";
    proxy_read_timeout 7d;
}
```

### 6. deploy-network.sh integration

**Existing file**: `deploy/deploy-network.sh`

The script already handles:
- `services0-sockets` dinit install
- `openclaw-socket.service` install into container
- `--install-dashboard-nginx` flag renders the template
- `--update-wgconf` / `--update-wgcf` flags for WireGuard writes
- NextDNS rewrite via `deploy/nextdns/upsert-rewrite.py`

### 7. User container template

Name: `user-<sha256(wg_pubkey)[:12]>`

Devices:
```yaml
sockets:
  type: disk
  source: /run/user-sockets/<container-id>
  path: /run/sockets
```

Metadata: `user.wg-pubkey: <key>`

Host directory `/run/user-sockets/<container-id>` must be created before
container start (tmpfs, recreated on boot).

## Filesystem Permissions

| Path | Owner | Mode |
|---|---|---|
| `/run/services0` | `root:_nginx` | `0770` |
| `/run/services0/gateway.sock` | `root:_nginx` | `0660` |
| `/run/user-sockets` | `root:root` | `0755` |
| `/run/user-sockets/<id>` | `root:root` | `0777` |

## Verification Commands

```sh
incus exec services -- cat /proc/net/dev
incus exec services -- ss -tlnp | grep 18789
doas curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' \
  --unix-socket /run/services0/gateway.sock http://localhost/
curl -sk -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' \
  https://10.0.0.1/gateway/ -H 'Host: dashboard.3tched.com'
curl -sk -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' \
  https://148.113.204.83/gateway/ -H 'Host: dashboard.3tched.com'
incus exec services -- \
  systemctl --user --machine=jeremy@ is-enabled openclaw-gateway.service
```

## Known Gaps

1. `privacy-xray-ingress` and `xray-server` still have `eth0`.
2. NextDNS rewrite requires `NEXTDNS_API_KEY` (not present on host).
3. `wgcf` handshake was stale at last check.
4. `wg0.conf` has invalid `DNS=` lines in `[Peer]` sections.
```

# Socket-Based Container Networking — Product Requirements Document

## Overview

The `services` Incus container (running OpenClaw gateway, Maddy mail, NextDNS)
must be reachable from WireGuard-authenticated clients without exposing any
container IP address or TCP port. The access path is:

```
WireGuard client → host wg0 → nginx (10.0.0.1) → Unix socket → container loopback
```

## Problem Statement

Previously the `services` container had an `eth0` NIC on `incusbr0` with a
static IP, and a WireGuard peer (`wg0` at `10.0.0.4`). This exposed container
IPs to the network, created scannable TCP ports, and required a separate
WireGuard peer per container. The goal is to eliminate all of that.

## User Stories

**US-1** — As a WireGuard client (tablet, laptop), I can reach the OpenClaw
gateway at `https://dashboard.3tched.com/gateway/` without knowing or routing
to any container IP address.

**US-2** — As an operator, I can add a new service to the `services` container
by adding a socat bridge unit and an nginx location block, without changing
container networking.

**US-3** — As a security reviewer, I can verify that no container has a
routable IP or open TCP port by inspecting `/proc/net/dev` inside each
container.

**US-4** — As an operator, I can run `deploy/deploy-network.sh` on a fresh
host and have the full socket gateway path come up without manual steps.

**US-5** — As a WireGuard client, `dashboard.3tched.com` resolves to
`10.0.0.1` through NextDNS split DNS so my browser reaches the WG-bound nginx
listener automatically.

## Functional Requirements

### FR-1: No container network interfaces
Socket-mode containers MUST have only `lo`. No veth, no `eth0`, no `wg0`.

### FR-2: Default Incus profile has no NIC
The Incus `default` profile MUST NOT define an `eth0` device.

### FR-3: Services bind to loopback
All services inside `services` MUST bind to `127.0.0.1` only.

### FR-4: Unix socket bridge per service
Each service needing host access MUST have a socat bridge from
`/run/services0/<name>.sock` to `127.0.0.1:<port>`.

Current required bridge: `gateway.sock → 127.0.0.1:18789`

### FR-5: Shared socket directory `/run/services0`
The `services` container MUST have an Incus disk device `services0` mounting
`/run/services0` from host into container at the same path.

### FR-6: Per-user socket directories
User containers created by the magic-link flow MUST receive
`/run/user-sockets/<container-id>` on the host, mounted as `/run/sockets`
inside the container.

### FR-7: Container identity metadata
- System containers: `user.function = system-services`
- User containers: `user.wg-pubkey = <key>`, name = `user-<sha256(key)[:12]>`

### FR-8: nginx is the only network-facing proxy
nginx on the host MUST proxy `/gateway/` to
`http://unix:/run/services0/gateway.sock:/` on the WG-bound listener only.

### FR-9: No stack-revealing service names
There MUST NOT be an active `openclaw.3tched.com` nginx config. The public
path is `/gateway/` under `dashboard.3tched.com`.

### FR-10: WireGuard gates dashboard access
The dashboard nginx server block MUST listen on `10.0.0.1:80` and
`10.0.0.1:443` only. Public IP listeners for `dashboard.3tched.com` return
`404` (certificate sink only).

### FR-11: Token auth injected by nginx
nginx MUST inject the OpenClaw bearer token. The token MUST NOT appear in
documentation or specs — use `<redacted>`.

### FR-12: One gateway process owner
Only the root systemd unit inside `services` may own port `18789`. The
user-level `jeremy` unit MUST remain disabled.

### FR-13: NextDNS split DNS
NextDNS profile `689ec7` MUST carry a rewrite: `dashboard.3tched.com → 10.0.0.1`.

## Non-Functional Requirements

### NFR-1: Reduced attack surface
No container IPs, no container TCP ports, no per-service subdomains.

### NFR-2: Low-latency local transport
Host-to-container hop uses Unix sockets (no TCP/IP routing between namespaces).

### NFR-3: Boot resilience
`/run/services0` is tmpfs and MUST be recreated before Incus and nginx start.
The `services0-sockets` dinit service owns this. Incus and nginx MUST depend
on it.

### NFR-4: Deployment script is idempotent
`deploy/deploy-network.sh` default runs MUST NOT rotate WireGuard keys or
rewrite WireGuard config. Those are opt-in via `--update-wgconf` /
`--update-wgcf`.

### NFR-5: Verification-first
Changes MUST be verifiable with read-only checks before and after:
- `incus exec services -- cat /proc/net/dev`
- `doas curl --unix-socket /run/services0/gateway.sock http://localhost/`
- `curl -sk https://10.0.0.1/gateway/ -H 'Host: dashboard.3tched.com'`

## Out of Scope

- `privacy-xray-ingress` and `xray-server` migration (separate task)
- NextDNS rewrite automation when `NEXTDNS_API_KEY` is unavailable
- OpenFlow `sock_*` dynamic container port model (future)
- gRPC-over-Unix-socket refactor for `op-dbus` ↔ OpenClaw (separate task)
